hints: BIG Satu Peta MapServer layer 10 'Hak Milik 1:5000' (ATR/BPN land-ownership parcels) has per-province sublayers; Jawa Barat (layer 21), Jawa Timur (12), DI Yogyakarta (13), Jawa Tengah (25) are verified; the earlier note said 15 provinces have sublayers and DKI Jakarta is not among them. First list the MapServer's sublayers and test the one for your province with a bounded query (coverage is patchy: use a few boxes in the capital). Then check the provincial geoportal / Simpul Jaringan (e.g. geoportal.<prov>.go.id, jakartasatu.jakarta.go.id for DKI) and BPN Bhumi (token-gated). Record 'no sublayer' vs 'sublayer but empty' vs verified.
